solution: <answer>The video showcases the traditional method of eating LA galbi, a popular Korean BBQ dish. The text at the bottom changes to '깻잎, 상추에 갈비 한두 개, 마늘, 양파를 넣습니다' (Add one or two pieces of galbi, garlic, and onion to the perilla leaf and lettuce) and '山芝麻叶，生菜里加入排骨肉，蒜，洋葱' (Add galbi meat, garlic, and onion to the perilla leaf and lettuce).
